system.description:
Will Amp

Crash symbolizes you releasing the limits on your chakra coils, empowering the jutsu you cast.

Once per casting, you gain a +1d10 bonus to damage you deal with Ninjutsu you cast. This increases to +2d10 at 7th, 3d10 at 11th, 4d10 at 15th and 5d10 at 19th level. Reduce the dice rolled by half (rounded up) if the jutsu affects an area.

You can use two or more Moldings at once as part of the same casting.

You can use the Draw Reserves skill Action, as an Action.

You cannot benefit from any source of cost reduction. Casting a Jutsu at 0 Cost does not count as cost reduction.

Crash and Flow share 1 minute; a Bonus Action swaps once per turn; 10 minutes of rest or meditation before entering again.
system.summary: Ninjutsu deal +1d10 to +5d10 once per casting; several Moldings at once; Draw Reserves as an Action; no cost reduction.

rules.text: Once per casting, Ninjutsu you cast deal +1d10 damage (2d10 at 7th, 3d10 at 11th, 4d10 at 15th, 5d10 at 19th; half the dice for an area). This is added automatically when you cast.
You can use two or more Moldings on one casting; you can use the Draw Reserves skill action as an Action.
